<noinclude>
Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Template:Infobox
History: https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Template:Infobox&action=history
Revision: https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Template:Infobox&oldid=855069164 (08/15/2018 6:33 PM UTC)
Adapted by phpBB Modders.
Changes: rewritten in plain wiki text without Lua (Module:Infobox) as a table of the parameters Wikipedia's infobox takes: title, above, subheader, image with its caption (shown only with an image), below, and 20 numbered rows, each a header, a label with its data, or data alone (a label without data is left out, as on Wikipedia); no subheader2 or image2 and up, no child infoboxes, class, style, bodystyle or autoheaders options, and no float to the right, since the wiki lets no class or style through; removed the source's documentation and tracking categories.
Example: {{Infobox|title=Wiki|above=phpBB extension|label1=Version|data1=1.1.0|label2=Licence|data2=GPL-2.0|below=phpBB Modders}}
Example: {{Infobox|title=Board|header1=Software|label2=Name|data2=phpBB|label3=Empty|data4=A row with no label|header5=Hosting|label6=Host|data6=Self-hosted}}
Example: {{Infobox|title=Template|subheader=Just a test|caption=No image here|label20=Last row|data20=Twenty}}
Licence: CC BY-SA 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/
